about: The 3 v1 weapons. Each is a new weapon record that reuses a vanilla New Vegas model (no new meshes, nothing from CS2). Stats null = not yet chosen/verified against the base weapon in the game data.

columns.id: unique weapon id (also the editor ID in the plugin)
columns.name: in-game name (original, CS-flavoured, not a Valve trademark)
columns.base_form: vanilla weapon whose model/sounds are reused
columns.verified: true once fired in the running game
